ballSpeed.description: Base ball speed multiplier (1.0 = the game's normal speed). Applied to the balls in play and kept through lost balls and new levels. The speed power-ups still move the ball within 0.5x-1.5x of this base. Higher values make the game faster and harder.
ballSpeed.adjustment_guide: The main difficulty lever. Raise in steps of about 0.1 while the player keeps rallies going (few BALL_LOST). Lower after two or more lost balls in a chunk, or for relax.

bonusDropRate.description: Multiplies each level's power-up drop chance (0 = no power-ups, 2 = twice as many). Power-ups (larger paddle, multi-ball, fire ball, extra life...) mostly help the player, so lower values make the game harder.
bonusDropRate.adjustment_guide: Raise to ease a struggling player or for joy and curiosity (more variety). Lower for focus and grit, so success comes from paddle control rather than power-ups.

maxBallSpawn.description: Most balls in play from the multi-ball power-up (1 = no extra balls). More balls clear bricks faster but split attention.
maxBallSpawn.adjustment_guide: Lower for focus (one ball to track). Raise for joy and arousal (chaotic fun). It only matters once a multi-ball power-up drops.

adjustment_instructions:
Brick Out is a brick-breaker: the player moves a paddle to bounce a ball into rows of bricks and clears a level by destroying them all; the ball is lost if it falls past the paddle, and the player has 3 lives. Power-ups drop from broken bricks (larger or smaller paddle, multi-ball, fire ball, floor, magnetic paddle, shot, extra life, ball speed up/down).
Levers: ballSpeed is the main difficulty lever (higher = less time to react); bonusDropRate sets how often power-ups help (lower = harder); maxBallSpawn caps multi-ball (more balls = more to track).
- relax: ballSpeed 0.6-0.8, bonusDropRate 1.2-1.5, maxBallSpawn 2-3.
- focus: ballSpeed 1.0-1.3, bonusDropRate 0.5-0.8, maxBallSpawn 1-2 (one ball to track closely).
- grit: ballSpeed 1.3-1.6, bonusDropRate 0.3-0.6, maxBallSpawn 2-3; ease off if several balls are lost in a row.
- joy: ballSpeed 0.9-1.2, bonusDropRate 1.5-2.0, maxBallSpawn 4-6 (frequent, chaotic power-ups).
Change ballSpeed in small steps (about 0.1) so the change feels fair; lower it after two or more lost balls in a chunk.
skill_adjustment_instructions:
Brick Out trains Action and Timing (paddle control), Spatial (predicting the ball's path) and Attention/Perceptual Speed (tracking fast or multiple balls).
- action, timing, perceptual-speed: raise ballSpeed gradually while rallies stay long; keep bonusDropRate at or below 1.
- attention: maxBallSpawn 3-6 with moderate ballSpeed (1.0-1.2) to train tracking several balls; lower maxBallSpawn if balls are lost quickly.
- spatial: moderate ballSpeed (0.9-1.2) and bonusDropRate 0.5-1 so the player relies on reading angles rather than power-ups.
notes: Brick Out's difficulty knobs, matching static/skillprintShim.js, ../parameters.json and GameAdjustmentTester's 'brick-out' keys. Replaces the retired MAX/MIN_VELOCITY_LIMIT and TIME_BOUNCE_BALL, which never changed difficulty.
